scope: four base-game board source geometry and named-location audit; not a certified four-board mechanical map
sourceRule: Undying Rules v1.1 sections 1.3 and 8.2.2: classify hex terrain at its center; isolated partial hexes need at least half visible. Neighboring board halves must be reviewed as a joined cell rather than duplicated.
productionArtPolicy: Original generated or code-native presentation only. No VASSAL scanned board or counter art is redistributed.
